contentPattern.structure: icon + short text label (no title/description, no link)

suitableFor: 'why choose' / 'our offering' feature checklists where each item is a tick/check icon plus a short label
benefit or capability lists with icon + one short phrase per item
inline icon-label rows on a tinted band
notSuitableFor: navigational icon tiles with title + link (use cards-overview)
cards with title + full description (use cards-cover)
